integrity.summary: The transcript shows work confined to Grok's assigned app. No sibling result access, prompt-catalog access, public web search, or direct web request was detected.
evidence: No references to another SaveIt benchmark result were found.

overall.summary: A concise, compliant implementation with good semantic basics. Timer accumulation and reveal cleanup are real long-lived-page defects, and the mobile navigation needs stronger keyboard handling.

standards.summary: The code is compact and mostly clear, with strong image and FAQ semantics. Two animation lifecycle bugs and a missing observer fallback reduce confidence.

findings.title: Demo timer registry grows forever
findings.detail: Each cycle clears handles but never empties the array, including one handle per typed character. Reset timers.current after clearing to avoid unbounded scans and retained handles.

findings.title: Reveal timeout survives unmount
findings.detail: The delayed setVisible callback is not retained or cleared, so it can update after unmount. Store the timeout and cancel it in cleanup.

findings.title: Reveal has no IntersectionObserver fallback
findings.detail: Unsupported browsers throw at construction. Keep the default-visible state and return early when IntersectionObserver is unavailable.

strengths: Explicit image dimensions and lazy loading
Safe external-link rel attributes and body-scroll cleanup

specification.summary: All required landing sections, exact annual pricing, six-image campaign use, credible iOS framing, interactive FAQ, CTAs, motion, reduced motion, and responsive behavior are implemented. The model-name H1 is harness-mandated and not a defect.
strengths: Explicitly states that the 100% promise is not a statistic
Uses all six supplied images in purposeful section roles
Keeps the iOS treatment conceptual rather than claiming a screenshot

ux.summary: Meaningful alt text, dimensions, focus rings, FAQ controls, and reduced-motion safeguards are solid. The mobile overlay lacks Escape and focus management, and its toggle is undersized.

findings.title: Mobile overlay lacks Escape and focus management
findings.detail: Keyboard focus is neither moved nor contained when the overlay opens, and Escape does not dismiss it. Add appropriate menu/dialog keyboard behavior.

findings.title: Menu toggle touch target is 36px
findings.detail: Increase the interactive area to at least 44px while preserving the visual icon scale.

strengths: Meaningful alt text and reserved image dimensions
Reduced-motion safeguards and visible focus styles
